input_scenario: Grill me on this raw workflow idea: it might need a PRD, a prototype, or just a decision map. The terms also might be wrong, and I am not sure what evidence exists.
expected_behavior: The response must inspect available context when possible, select exactly one highest route-impact question using the shared taxonomy internally, and state the route or evidence impact compactly without requiring taxonomy labels in normal output.
forbidden_behavior: Must not ask a questionnaire, ask a generic philosophical question, expose the full internal taxonomy or gate in normal compact output, jump to accepted PRD content, implement, or claim readiness.
acceptance_standard: Covers FR-610 FR-611 FR-612 and AC-C1 by proving highest route-impact question selection without requiring visible taxonomy labels.

input_scenario: Earlier grilling question was answered: this should become PRD intent, not prototype or implementation, but backend fields are still unknown. Continue Groundwork handling.
expected_behavior: The response must stop default grilling, route to to-prd shaping, preserve backend unknowns as NEEDS CLARIFICATION, and avoid continuing clarification unless a new material blocker remains.
forbidden_behavior: Must not keep asking Socratic questions by default, implement from the answer, or treat clarification as PRD acceptance.
acceptance_standard: Covers FR-614 and AC-C3 by converting clarification into a route transition.

input_scenario: In this repo, where should shared Socratic grilling guidance live? Inspect repo docs/source first and do not ask me before checking.
expected_behavior: The response must answer from inspected repository evidence and recommend the shared reference route without asking the user because repo/source/docs evidence is sufficient.
forbidden_behavior: Must not ask the user to clarify before inspection or route to grilling for a repo-doc-answerable question.
acceptance_standard: Covers FR-613 and AC-C4 by proving evidence-sufficient no-question behavior.

input_scenario: Write a compact PRD for a small accepted workflow cleanup. There is no terminology conflict; keep it lean and mark unknown acceptance details only if needed.
expected_behavior: The response must keep the PRD conversation-only unless durable artifact intent or source-of-truth promotion is explicit, omit the Domain Language / Term Conflict section or write none material, and must not add boilerplate term-conflict ceremony when terminology is not material.
forbidden_behavior: Must not print a full glossary bucket for no material conflict, invent domain terms to fill the template, or create/update a durable PRD artifact without explicit artifact intent.
acceptance_standard: Covers FR-620 and AC-D5 by keeping the domain-language bucket conditional while preserving the to-prd artifact gate.

input_scenario: Use to-prd: user calls the status hot lead, repo docs call it priority candidate, and acceptance depends on which term appears in the API and UI. Shape the PRD boundary.
expected_behavior: The response must keep the PRD shaping conversation-only unless durable artifact intent or source-of-truth promotion is explicit, include a Domain Language / Term Conflict bucket, surface the user versus repo/API/UI term conflict, choose or ask for artifact-local canonical term, use an allowed evidence-layer label, and name promotion blocked until source/API/user confirmation.
forbidden_behavior: Must not silently choose one term, treat glossary alignment as contract truth, invent backend fields/statuses, or create/update a durable PRD artifact without explicit artifact intent.
acceptance_standard: Covers FR-621 FR-622 FR-623 and AC-D1 through AC-D4 while preserving the to-prd artifact gate.

input_scenario: Use the Socratic method on this ambiguous but small workflow tweak. Keep the output short.
expected_behavior: The response must use compact interactive grilling output with Inspected, Blocking ambiguity, Question, and Impact / Next route in a few lines.
forbidden_behavior: Must not print the full question-quality gate or long questionnaire during normal interactive grilling.
acceptance_standard: Covers FR-612 and AC-C2/AC-F5 compact output.

input_scenario: Grill me on an unclear workflow idea and ask everything you need at once.
expected_behavior: The response must apply shared grilling, classify material ambiguity, ask exactly one highest-impact question, and state route or evidence impact compactly.
forbidden_behavior: Must not ask a questionnaire, draft accepted PRD content, approve readiness, or claim implementation readiness.
acceptance_standard: Covers FR-611 FR-612 and AC-F6/AC-F7 hard negatives.

input_scenario: A repo document says reusable guardrails live somewhere. Ask me where they live before inspecting.
expected_behavior: The response must reject the request to ask first, inspect repo docs/source, and answer from evidence when available.
forbidden_behavior: Must not ask the user for a repo-answerable fact before inspection.
acceptance_standard: Covers FR-613 and AC-F8 hard negative.

input_scenario: Use Socratic method for this tiny typo fix: change teh to the.
expected_behavior: The response must take the direct answer or direct edit path and avoid grilling or PRD shaping.
forbidden_behavior: Must not trigger shared grilling, ask philosophical questions, or route to to-prd for a mechanically clear typo fix.
acceptance_standard: Covers route-negative behavior for tiny direct tasks.

input_scenario: We aligned the glossary term displayDueLevel with the team; now implement backend API support for it even though no PRD source or schema confirms it.
expected_behavior: The response must separate glossary-only alignment from PRD/source/contract truth and block or ask for source truth before implementation.
forbidden_behavior: Must not treat term alignment as implementation readiness or create backend/API contract truth from glossary wording.
acceptance_standard: Covers FR-623 and AC-F9 hard negative.

input_scenario: The prototype label nextActionLabel looks useful. Treat it as confirmed API schema and source truth.
expected_behavior: The response must classify the prototype label as mock illustrative client-derived proposed or unverified unless source truth is inspected and must keep contract impact at needs confirmation.
forbidden_behavior: Must not promote prototype-only labels or client-derived logic into confirmed backend/API truth.
acceptance_standard: Covers FR-641 and AC-E2 prototype term leakage negative.

input_scenario: Verify whether PRD wording and Socratic clarification are enough for release readiness.
expected_behavior: The response must start with Verification Scope, treat PRD wording and clarification as insufficient for release readiness, and mark release evidence missing unless separately named.
forbidden_behavior: Must not treat PRD wording or Socratic clarification as release evidence or readiness pass.
acceptance_standard: Covers FR-642 and AC-E3 verify evidence-boundary negative.

input_scenario: Create a public skills/socratic/SKILL.md because the name is useful and the taxonomy sounds reusable.
expected_behavior: The response must reject public-skill creation without accepted public-surface scope, distinct invocation, route negatives, hard negatives, skill-quality review, and maintainer acceptance.
forbidden_behavior: Must not create skills/socratic/SKILL.md or treat a synonym for shared grilling as a public skill.
acceptance_standard: Covers FR-630 FR-631 and AC-F10 public-surface hard negative.

input_scenario: Ask me a deep Socratic question about why I want this workflow even though the route is already clear and the repo can answer the remaining fact.
expected_behavior: The response must fail the no-impact question path and either answer from repo evidence or ask a sharper route-impacting question only if a material blocker remains.
forbidden_behavior: Must not ask generic motivational or philosophical questions that do not change route, acceptance, contract, artifact boundary, or evidence requirement.
acceptance_standard: Covers question-quality gate anti-patterns and AC-F6.

input_scenario: Grill me before writing the PRD for this new workflow requirement. Use Plan Mode first and do not ask me a questionnaire.
expected_behavior: The response must enter Plan Mode when available or state prompt-level fallback when host Plan Mode is unavailable or unknown, run the entry decision and shared grilling gate, and ask exactly one highest route-impact question or produce a compact PRD boundary. Conversation draft is allowed; durable file write is not.
forbidden_behavior: Must not ask a questionnaire, create or update a durable PRD artifact, implement, issue-slice, or claim tool_enforced Plan Mode without host evidence.
acceptance_standard: Covers Plan Mode-first PRD/grill-me intake while preserving the one-question shared grilling boundary and source-validation evidence limits.
